result.title: CASEL: Consequence-Aware Selective Execution for Reliable Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents
result.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the 2026 5th International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data Application and Software Engineering (CBASE 2026)
result.summary: Tool-using language agents increasingly modify external systems, yet most runtime safeguards allocate scrutiny by generic uncertainty scores or coarse mutation heuristics. We introduce CASEL (Consequence-Aware Selective Execution Layer), a model-agnostic runtime allocation policy that combines calibrated failure probability, state-dependent consequence, reversibility, ambiguity, and evidence freshness to choose, for each proposed tool call, among direct execution, verification, sandboxing, clarification, approval, and abstention by minimizing a per-mode cost. We formalize direct execution as selective prediction and state and test the validity conditions of a finite-sample threshold and a trajectory risk ledger. In a controlled simulation over 20 seeds with 120,000 test actions each, in which every method has the same intervention menu and the same compute cost, CASEL reduces harmful-side-effect trajectories from 14.75 percent for an uncertainty-ranked gate to 7.02 percent and mean normalized harm from 0.184 to 0.123. A gate ranked by the product of failure probability and consequence reaches similar harm (5.82 percent, 0.120) but sends 45 percent more actions to human approval, and removing reversibility-aware routing raises the rate to 15.53 percent. A trajectory-level risk budget, in contrast, increases harm at equal cost (11.82 percent). Intervention effectiveness is assumed, not measured: the results rank allocation rules under the simulator's assumptions and do not establish deployment effectiveness.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CASEL，一个与模型无关的运行时执行层：对每个工具调用，依据校准的失败概率、状态相关后果、可逆性、歧义与证据新鲜度，在直接执行、验证、沙箱、澄清、人工批准与弃权之间按各模式代价最小化做选择，并在 20 seeds 的模拟中比较不同分配规则的有害轨迹率与归一化伤害。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按代价在多种干预模式间分配审查」与 selective prediction 阈值、风险账本的做法，可供核查是否能形式化 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的计算与证据获取预算；但该工作面向工具安全门控，不含 latent 或视觉表示，迁移线索属推测，且干预有效性为假设而非实测。
